summary: Following changes to price targets from multiple analysts, Datadog, Inc. (NASDAQ:DDOG) climbed 7.7%. On July 28, 2026, analysts at Morgan Stanley, BTIG, and Citi raised their price targets on Datadog to $300, $289, and $300, respectively, reflecting changes between 11%-33%, while maintaining bullish ratings. headline: Datadog (DDOG) Partners With Cloudaware To Bring LogSight To Its Marketplace
summary: Datadog and Cloudaware have partnered to list Cloudaware LogSight on the Datadog Marketplace. The integration aims to give Datadog clients wider cloud log coverage and stronger visibility across multi cloud environments. The new offering focuses on automated discovery and onboarding of previously unmonitored log sources to support monitoring and compliance needs.
